name: Toe boards, kick plates and edge protection
description: Low upstand plates at the edge of decks and platforms stop tools and material falling. They are part of the dropped-object regime alongside gratings and guardrails.

gaps.why: No page read gives a toe-board height or its fixing detail.
gaps.next_action: Fetch ISO 14122-3 or an outfitting standard and record height and fixing
